claim.summary: Full ideal relaxation ceiling: over F_2 with Boolean axioms, let S be a point set and E a degree with I(S) cap B_{<=E} inside the degree-E closure of Gamma_0. (1) A further constraint f of degree <= E with no zero on S is refuted at E, since f + 1 lies in I(S). (2) Further constraints of degree <= w with no common zero on S are refuted at E when E >= rho(S) + w, rho(S) the interpolation degree of S (2^rho <= |S|). So a relaxation solved at the cutoff carries no barrier with one constraint, and with several only below rho(S) + w; for pigeonhole this gives n + 1 and is not tight.
